contexts.text: It is like a meteor... which vanishes. TCR 42:end.
I saw a meteor. Described, Explained. TCR 697.
It was a meteor which the common people call a dragon. Described, Explained.
Below these meteors stood some who were disputing about imaginary things...
Which are nothing but meteors, and disappear of themselves.
Not knowing that a falling star is a meteor from fatuous light, which when it falls into the brain can confirm every falsity, which is done by means of fallacies...
